verdict.rationale: Penpot's docs describe an official MCP server that lets external AI agents/LLMs read and interact with Penpot files to 'generate editable design structures' and 'create high-fidelity artifacts' from prompts (penpot-docs-31, penpot-docs-32, penpot-docs-40), which supports the story's intent of prompt-driven design generation. However, this is achieved only via connecting a third-party AI agent through MCP rather than a native in-app 'type a prompt, get a mockup' feature, and there is no independent/hands-on evidence confirming actual generated layouts or mockups working in practice. Missing for 10: first-party demo/screenshots of actual generated designs, independent hands-on reports validating the MCP-to-mockup pipeline, and a native in-app generation UI not dependent on external agent setup.
